evidence: The surface morphology of each grown film was observed by an atomic force microscope (AFM). In this work, the AFM measurement was performed using the NV2000 (Olympus) in the noncontact mode in the atmosphere. All images from the AFM were obtained using Si tips with a curvature radius of 15nm and a resonance frequency of 260–410kHz. The images were obtained with a resolution of 512/C2256 at several scan sizes. The surface roughness was represented by the root-mean-square (RMS) value determined over an area of 5.0mm /C25.0mm.
